A29-15.note: Fixed as insight_review._default_reviewer does it: InsightReviewDeps::judge now takes the least per-question budget (REVIEW_TIMEOUT_S 12) and the review asks with no timeout of its own, so the judge's own budget applies. The app builds the review judge with build_review_judge: null unless Fast judgments are on and the chosen route is device-local (a29-local-meeting-judgments), else judge_from_settings with JudgeOptions.timeout_s = max(12, route.timeout_s): 30 s on the local text-model route, 12 s for a route with a shorter budget. RuntimeDeps/EngineDeps::local_review_judge carries it to the dashboard review and End's review (falls back to local_fast_judge when a composition sets none). Python has no total budget over a review: four workers each ask one question per item with the judge's per-question budget, as here. Tests: 'the review builds its judge with at least the review timeout and asks without one', 'the review judge waits the longer of the review timeout and the route's budget'.
